polarfire_smoke.command:
ssh -o ConnectTimeout=5 -o BatchMode=yes polarfire 'python3 - <<'"'"'PY'"'"'
import json, math
payload = '"'"'{"board": "polarfire", "edges": [[0, 1, 1], [1, 2, -1], [2, 3, 1], [3, 4, -1], [4, 5, 1], [6, 7, 1]], "expected_energy": 6, "experiment_id": "exp5231-hardware-continuity-pbit-boundary-v478", "spins": [1, -1, -1, 1, 1, -1, 1, -1], "workload": "exp5231_inline_ising_energy_smoke"}'"'"'
data = json.loads(payload)
spins = [int(value) for value in data['"'"'spins'"'"']]
energy = 0
for row, col, coupling in data['"'"'edges'"'"']:
    energy -= int(coupling) * spins[int(row)] * spins[int(col)]
print(json.dumps({
    '"'"'workload_sha256'"'"': '"'"'19ca89d982db8bc434f37edfc6c52ca2c4cd510f2cc80f9547d7ff3ca5b080c2'"'"',
    '"'"'executable_sha256'"'"': '"'"'5495cb60e38bb94d076fc8628a8c6ab63900cdc887b59bffcc4a8249d57973d0'"'"',
    '"'"'inference_substrate'"'"': '"'"'hardware_reachability_and_sampler_boundary_plan'"'"',
    '"'"'energy'"'"': energy,
    '"'"'sample_quality'"'"': {'"'"'sample_count'"'"': len(spins), '"'"'finite_energy'"'"': math.isfinite(float(energy))},
    '"'"'correctness'"'"': {'"'"'energy_matches_expected'"'"': energy == data['"'"'expected_energy'"'"']},
}, sort_keys=True))
PY'

field_principles.gatemate_idcode_raw: preserve the raw v477 IDCODE evidence or record the bounded recheck result.
field_principles.gatemate_status: preserve the physical/JTAG blocker unless the operator changed the setup.
field_principles.hardware_docs_updated: true only when the p-bit plan and hardware wishlist note were written.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Must start with complete:/complete_/success:/success_ and state reachability plus no-speedup status.
field_principles.inference_substrate: declares this as reachability plus sampler-boundary planning evidence.
field_principles.kv260_check_method: records the SSH-only method so host-storage preconditions cannot creep back in.
field_principles.kv260_reachable: true only when the KV260 SSH BatchMode precondition exits zero.
field_principles.pbit_boundary_plan_path: points to the future sampler timing-ratio plan, not a benchmark result.
field_principles.polarfire_reachable: true only when the PolarFire SSH precondition exits zero.
field_principles.speedup_claimed: No .478 hardware task may claim speedup without a real end-to-end workload.

gatemate_check_note: preserved v477 physical/JTAG block; no operator cable, port, or board setup change was provided
gatemate_next_physical_action: operator reseat or replace GateMate JTAG cable/port path and verify board power before another IDCODE loop

pbit_boundary_plan.measurement_before_speedup: same workload/seeds/partitions/exchange schedule, end-to-end wall clock, boundary-transfer overhead, and hash/correctness parity on each substrate

prior_gatemate_reference.status: physical/JTAG block preserved unless operator setup changed
